subject.title: fix(cron): cap trigger script tool access

question: Should this P0 hardening ship forward-only now, or must existing cap-less trigger-script jobs be quarantined before release?
rationale: Historical rows cannot distinguish restricted-agent jobs from legitimate unrestricted operator jobs, so preserving or stopping those jobs changes a shipped security and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Ship Forward Protection Now
options.body: Land the proven forward hardening and require operator-facing guidance or an audit flow for pre-existing cap-less trigger jobs.

options.title: Quarantine Legacy Triggers
options.body: Block cap-less trigger evaluation until operators explicitly review and re-save each historical job with an approved policy.

options.title: Pause for Provenance Design
options.body: Hold the PR while designing a broader migration or provenance model that can classify historical jobs.

recommendation.title: Ship Forward Protection Now
recommendation.body: Land the proven forward hardening and require operator-facing guidance or an audit flow for pre-existing cap-less trigger jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent authorization and cron-runtime work most directly spans the security and compatibility boundary requiring a decision.
